tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (17.9:1).

tokens.name: racing-red
tokens.usage: Ferrari passion, competition fire, emergency braking,. Used as text on `.logo:hover`, `.btn-outline`, `.footer-links a:hover`. 3.9:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: carbon-black-deep
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.gallery-badge`, `.badge-auction`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: checkered-white
tokens.usage: Starting grid lines, finish line victory, flag. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link`, `.page-title`. 17.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: championship-gold
tokens.usage: Victory trophies, winner's laurels, premium. Used as text on `.podium-position`, `th`, `.footer-section h3`. 8.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: pit-silver
tokens.usage: Technical instruments, timing equipment, aluminum. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.podium-value`. 7.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: safety-orange
tokens.usage: Marshal flags, safety barriers, warning systems,. Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`. 8.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: btn-secondary-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `.stat-card`, `.podium-section`, `.gallery-card`; background on `.btn-secondary`.

tokens.name: stat-card-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `body`, `.stat-card`, `.podium-section`.

tokens.name: stat-card-bg-2
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.stat-card`, `.podium-section`, `.podium-card`.

tokens.name: podium-card-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.podium-card`, `input[type="text"], input[type="email"], input[typ`.

tokens.name: btn-secondary-bg-2
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-secondary:hover`.

styles.name: display

styles.name: heading-2

styles.name: button
